newsitem.title: USA: Banc One says has thousands of job openings.
newsitem.headline: Banc One says has thousands of job openings.

text.p: Banc One Corp said Friday it has openings for thousands of jobs and is having trouble finding applicants.

"We're aggressively hiring," Banc One spokesman John Russell said in a telephone interview. He cited a low jobless rate of 2.8 percent in Banc One's headquarters city of Columbus. He said Indianapolis and Milwaukee are two other cities where it is also difficult to get new employees.
The jobless rate for the U.S. as a whole fell to 5.1 percent in August, the lowest since 1989.
Russell said Banc One has 1,000 openings in Columbus, 1,000 in Dayton, Ohio, 500 in Milwaukee, 500 in Indianapolis, 1,000 in Houston and 1,000 in Phoenix.
The need for new applicants covers a "full range" of job skills, the spokesman said.

The company's need for new employees comes at a time when 5,000 positions are being eliminated but new positions are being created. When the process is completed, total employment is expected to remain around 50,000.

Russell said the company hopes to keep all of its current employees although some will be required to take new assignments. "It's much more efficient to keep an employee who understands the company than it is to hire a new employee and train them," Russell said.
Part of the need for new people arises from an annual turnover rate of 15 percent, equivalent to about 7,500 jobs.
The "re-engineering" is being conducted through a program known at the company as "Project One."

The bank holding company is consolidating its bank charters in the 12 states where it does busineess into one charter for each state. In Ohio, for example, 18 bank charters will be consolidated into a single charter. In most of the states where the company does business the process has already been completed.
With $97.1 billion in assets, Banc One is the 10th largest U.S. bank holding company.
